startPos = Main.Position
            end
        end)
        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if drag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                Main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end))
        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                drag = false
            end
        end))
    end

    -- Iconos normales: descarga en segundo plano y conserva el recurso original si falla.
    local YinIcons = { cache = {}, loading = {}, waiting = {} }
    function YinIcons.get(name, callback)
        if YinIcons.cache[name] then callback(YinIcons.cache[name]); return end
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return end
        local queue = YinIcons.waiting[name] or {}
        YinIcons.waiting[name] = queue
        table.insert(queue, callback)
        if YinIcons.loading[name] then return end
        YinIcons.loading[name] = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, asset = pcall(function()
                local path = "YinUI_Icon_v1_" .. name .. ".png"
                if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(path) then
                    local data = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YinScripts/Yin-UI/refs/heads/main/assets/iconos-yin/" .. name .. ".png")
                    if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 100 then return nil end
                    writefile(path, data)
                end
                return getcustomasset(path)
            end)
            YinIcons.loading[name] = nil
            local callbacks = YinIcons.waiting[name] or {}
            YinIcons.waiting[name] = nil
            if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
                YinIcons.cache[name] = asset
                for _, fn in ipairs(callbacks) do pcall(fn, asset) end
            end
        end)
    end
    function YinIcons.apply(image, name)
        if not image or not name then return end
        YinIcons.get(name, function(asset)
            if image.Parent and Theme.ThemeName ~= "Navidad" then
                image.Image = asset
                image.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end
        end)
    end
    YinIcons.tabs = { Home="home", Inicio="home", Favs="favorites", Favo="favorites", Themes="palette", Temas="palette", Effects="effects", Efectos="effects", Shaders="color_wheel", Settings="settings", Ajustes="settings", Chat="chat", Credits="info", ["Créditos"]="info", Logo="logo", Classic="diamonds", Spotify="music", ["Fan Art"]="fanart", All="all", Player="player", Players="players", Games="games", Map="map", Emotes="emotes", Movement="movement" }

    local function applyThemeExtras()
        CatImage.Visible = (Theme.ThemeName == "Dark") and not (Window and Window.CompactNavigation)
        TabListDivider.Visible = false -- v15: sin línea divisoria
        if Theme.TransparentTabs then
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        end
        if Window and Window.Tabs then
            for _, t in pairs(Window.Tabs) do
                if t.Button and t.Page then
                    t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = (Theme.TransparentTabs and not t.Page.Visible) and 1 or 0
                end
            end
        end
        local sizes = Theme.IconSizes or {}
        local windowIcons = Theme.WindowIcons or {}
        local controlSize = math.clamp(tonumber(sizes.Window) or 28, 16, 30)
        local searchSize = math.clamp(tonumber(sizes.Search) or 22, 14, 30)
        local controlKeys = { GlobalSearch = "Search", Minimize = "Minimize", Maximize = "Maximize", Close = "Close" }
        for _, control in ipairs(WindowControls:GetChildren()) do
            local key = controlKeys[control.Name]
            if key and control:IsA("ImageButton") then
                control.Image = windowIcons[key] or control:GetAttribute("DefaultImage") or control.Image
                if Theme.ThemeName ~= "Navidad" then YinIcons.apply(control, ({ Search="search", Minimize="minimize", Maximize="maximize", Close="close" })[key]) end
                local controlPx = key == "Search" and searchSize or controlSize
                control.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(controlPx, controlPx)
            end
        end
        local counterIcon = TopBarCounter:FindFirstChild("CounterIcon")
        if counterIcon then
            local counterSize = math.clamp(tonumber(sizes.Counter) or 24, 14, 28)
            counterIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(counterSize, counterSize)
            counterIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -(counterSize / 2))
            TopBarOnlineLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, counterSize + 4, 0.5, -9)
        end
        Boom.Paint()
    end
    applyThemeExtras()

    mk("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 0), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 0), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 0), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0)}, ContentArea)

    function Window._AddFavoriteFloatControls(holder, toggleFloating, toggleLock, getFloating, getLocked, onRefresh)
        if not holder or type(toggleFloating) ~= "function" or type(toggleLock) ~= "function" then return end

        holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 92)

        local FloatBtn = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 18),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            Text = "↗",
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 13,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 15,
        })
        corner(FloatBtn, 6)
        RowKit.Control(FloatBtn, true)

        local LockBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = holder,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 18),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438",
            ImageColor3 = Theme.Text,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 15,
        })
        corner(LockBtn, 6)
        stroke(LockBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
        RowKit.Control(LockBtn)

        local function refresh()
            local floating = false
            local locked = false
            pcall(function() floating = getFloating() end)
            pcall(function() locked = getLocked() end)
            FloatBtn.Text = floating and "←" or "↗"
            LockBtn.Image = locked and "rbxassetid://91959170037380" or "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
        end

        FloatBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            pcall(toggleFloating)
            refresh()
        end)
        LockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            pcall(toggleLock)
            refresh()
        end)
        refresh()
        if type(onRefresh) == "function" then
            pcall(onRefresh, refresh)
        end
    end

        local function makeControl(name, symbol, visible)
            -- Botón circular hundido, con doble flecha según el estado de navegación.
            local button = mk("TextButton", {
                Name = name, Parent = Body, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -40), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false, Visible = visible, ZIndex = 22,
            })
            button:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            corner(button, 999)
            local border = stroke(button, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)
            border:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Stroke")
            local scale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = button, Scale = 1})
            for i = 1, 2 do
                local arrow = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = button, Name = "Chevron" .. i,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7 + (i - 1) * 6, 1),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = symbol, TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 22, ZIndex = 23,
                })
                arrow:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            end
            button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {Scale = 1.06}):Play()
            end)
            button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            end)
            button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Scale = 0.92}):Play()
                end
            end)
            button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {Scale = 1}):Play()
                end
            end)
            return button
        end

        function Window._RefreshCompactNavigation()
            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                local entry = tab.CompactButton
                if entry and entry.Parent then
                    local active = tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible
                    entry.BackgroundColor3 = active and Theme.TabActive or Theme.Background
                    entry.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.06 or 0.26
                    local icon = entry:FindFirstChild("Icon")
                    if icon then icon.ImageColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Theme.Text end
                    local fallback = entry:FindFirstChild("Fallback")
                    if fallback then fallback.TextColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Theme.Text end
                    local indicator = entry:FindFirstChild("ActiveIndicator")
                    if indicator then indicator.Visible = active end
                end
            end
        end

        function Window._RegisterCompactTab(tab)
            if not tab or tab.CompactButton then return end
            local entry = mk("TextButton", {
                Name = "CompactTab_" .. tostring(tab.NameSpanish or "Tab"), Parent = nav.List,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,

            })
            entry:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            corner(entry, 11)
            stroke(entry, Theme.Stroke, 1.0, 0.42)
            local icon = tab.IconAsset
            if type(icon) == "string" and icon ~= "" then
                mk("ImageLabel", {
                    Name = "Icon", Parent = entry, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 25),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0.5, -12), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = icon, ImageColor3 = Theme.TabIcon or Theme.Text, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = 19,
                })
            else
                local fallback = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Name = "Fallback", Parent = entry, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = string.sub(tostring(tab.NameSpanish or "?"), 1, 1), TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, ZIndex = 19,
                })
                fallback:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            end
            local indicator = mk("Frame", {
                Name = "ActiveIndicator", Parent = entry, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 16),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, -5, 0.5, -8), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 20,
            })
            indicator:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(indicator, 999)
            entry.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if tab.Select then tab.Select() end
            end)
            entry.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if not (tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible) then
                    TweenService:Create(entry, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08}):Play()
                end
            end)
            entry.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if not (tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible) then
                    TweenService:Create(entry, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.26}):Play()
                end
            end)
            tab.CompactButton = entry
            Window._RefreshCompactNavigation()
        end

        function Window:SetCompactNavigation(enabled)
            nav.Compact = enabled == true
            self.CompactNavigation = nav.Compact
            TabList.Visible = not nav.Compact
            TabListArt.Visible = not nav.Compact
            TabListDivider.Visible = false -- v15: sin línea divisoria
            CatImage.Visible = (not nav.Compact) and Theme.ThemeName == "Dark"
            nav.Rail.Visible = nav.Compact
            nav.Open.Visible = not nav.Compact
            nav.Close.Visible = nav.Compact
            ContentArea.Position = nav.Compact and UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 118, 0, 0)
            ContentArea.Size = nav.Compact and UDim2.new(1, -58, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -118, 1, 0)
            Window._RefreshCompactNavigation()
        end

        nav.Open.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:SetCompactNavigation(true) end)
        nav.Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:SetCompactNavigation(false) end)
    end)()

    -- Iconos EXCLUSIVOS del tema Navidad: icono original -> icono navideño. Con cualquier otro tema vuelve el original.
    Window._NavidadIconMap = {
        ["rbxassetid://99086270459218"]  = "rbxassetid://71325091134162",  -- disco de la boombox
        ["rbxassetid://90955646581059"]  = "rbxassetid://85040129377925",  -- Players
        ["rbxassetid://80031485123484"]  = "rbxassetid://131034550856605", -- Ping
        ["rbxassetid://126144525731859"] = "rbxassetid://138261713959809", -- Server ID
        ["rbxassetid://128054256171328"] = "rbxassetid://116894523843499", -- Time
        ["rbxassetid://84609306530754"]  = "rbxassetid://134133702100421", -- Region

    Window._NavidadIcons = {}
    function Window._ApplyNavidadIcon(img)
        local base = img:GetAttribute("NavidadIconBase")
        if base == nil then
            base = img.Image
            img:SetAttribute("NavidadIconBase", base)
        end
        local nav = Theme.ThemeName == "Navidad" and Window._NavidadIconMap[base] or nil
        img.Image = nav or base
        if Theme.ThemeName ~= "Navidad" then YinIcons.apply(img, YinIcons.stats[base]) end
        return nav ~= nil
    end

    function Window._ApplyFullBackground()
        if not (BackgroundArt and BackgroundArt.Parent) then return end
        local full = Theme.FullBackground == true
        local artCorner = BackgroundArt:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if full then
            BackgroundArt.Parent = Main
            BackgroundArt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            local mainCorner = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if artCorner and mainCorner then artCorner.CornerRadius = mainCorner.CornerRadius end
        else
            BackgroundArt.Parent = ContentArea
            BackgroundArt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            BackgroundArt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 15, 1, 30)
            if artCorner then artCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) end
        end
        TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = full and 1 or 0
        -- textos legibles sobre la imagen (solo Navidad): contorno oscuro en el título, la insignia, el texto de
        -- abajo del boombox y los nombres de las pestañas. Con otro tema se restaura el contorno que tenían.
        local function strokeText(obj)
            if not (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
            if not (obj:GetAttribute("NavidadTextStroke") or obj:IsDescendantOf(TabList)) then return end
            if full then
                if obj:GetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeT") == nil then
                    obj:SetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeT", obj.TextStrokeTransparency)
                    obj:SetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeC", obj.TextStrokeColor3)
                end
                obj.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                obj.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
            elseif obj:GetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeT") ~= nil then
                obj.TextStrokeTransparency = obj:GetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeT")
                obj.TextStrokeColor3 = obj:GetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeC")
                obj:SetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeT", nil)
                obj:SetAttribute("NavOrigStrokeC", nil)
            end
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(TabList:GetDescendants()) do strokeText(obj) end
        for _, obj in ipairs(TopBar:GetDescendants()) do strokeText(obj) end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Main:GetChildren()) do strokeText(obj) end
        if Boom and Boom.Icon then
            local isNav = Window._ApplyNavidadIcon(Boom.Icon)
            Boom.Icon.Size = isNav and UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22) or UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
            Boom.Icon.ImageColor3 = isNav and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or getContrastColor(Theme.Accent)
        end
        for _, img in ipairs(Window._NavidadIcons) do
            if img.Parent then Window._ApplyNavidadIcon(img) end
        end
    end
    Window._ApplyFullBackground()
    -- al maximizar/restaurar cambia la esquina de Main: el fondo completo la sigue
    if Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
        Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("CornerRadius"):Connect(Window._ApplyFullBackground)
    end
    -- pestañas creadas después (las del script): con Navidad activo reciben el contorno (una sola pasada por frame)
    TabList.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
        if Theme.FullBackground ~= true or Window._FullBgQueued then return end
        Window._FullBgQueued = true
        task.defer(function()
            Window._FullBgQueued = false
            Window._ApplyFullBackground()
        end)
    end)


    local Overlay = mk("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 200,
    }, Main)

    local currentDropdownClose = nil

    local function attachDropdownBehavior(Holder, Click, Chevron, optionsCount, buildPopupContents)
        local isOpen = false
        local closePopup

        local function open()
            if currentDropdownClose then currentDropdownClose() end
            isOpen = true
            Chevron.Text = "^"

            local backdrop = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Overlay,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 201
            })

            local relX = Holder.AbsolutePosition.X - Main.AbsolutePosition.X
            local relY = Holder.AbsolutePosition.Y - Main.AbsolutePosition.Y + Holder.AbsoluteSize.Y + 4
            local itemH = 32
            local maxH = 160
            local contentH = math.max(optionsCount, 1) * (itemH + 4) + 8
            local popupH = math.min(contentH, maxH)

            local Popup = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
                Parent = Overlay,
                Position = UDim2.new(0, relX, 0, relY),
                Size = UDim2.new(0, Holder.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, popupH),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ScrollBarThickness = 3,
                ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
                CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0),
                AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                ZIndex = 202
            })
            Popup:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            corner(Popup, 6)
            stroke(Popup, Theme.Stroke, 1.5, 0)
            mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, Popup)
            mk("UIPadding", {
                PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4),
                PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
            }, Popup)

            closePopup = function()
                isOpen = false
                Chevron.Text = "v"
                backdrop:Destroy()
                Popup:Destroy()
                currentDropdownClose = nil
            end
            currentDropdownClose = closePopup
            backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closePopup() end)

            buildPopupContents(Popup, closePopup)
        end

        Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if isOpen then
                if closePopup then closePopup() end
            else
                open()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function keyNameToDisplay(keyName)
        if type(keyName) ~= "string" or keyName == "" then
            return GetText("Sin tecla", "No key")
        end

        local displayName = keyName
        pcall(function()
            local keyCode = Enum.KeyCode[keyName]
            if keyCode then
                local formatted = UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(
                    keyCode,
                    Enum.KeyCodeStringFormat.Short
                )
                if type(formatted) == "string" and formatted ~= "" then
                    displayName = formatted
                end
            end
        end)
        return displayName
    end

    local function updateKeybindButton(entry)
        if entry and entry.Button and entry.Button.Parent then
            entry.Button.Text = GetText("Tecla: ", "Key: ") .. keyNameToDisplay(entry.KeyName)
            entry.Button.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
        end
    end

    Window.BeginKeybindCapture = function(entry)
        if not entry or not entry.Button or not entry.Button.Parent then return end

        if Window._keybindCapture and Window._keybindCapture ~= entry then
            Window._keybindCapture.Capturing = false
            updateKeybindButton(Window._keybindCapture)
        end

        entry.Capturing = true
        Window._keybindCapture = entry
        entry.Button.Text = GetText("Pulsa una tecla", "Press a key")
        entry.Button.TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText
    end

    Window.RegisterKeybind = function(id, button, activate)
        if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or not button or type(activate) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end

        local entry = Window.Keybinds[id] or {}
        entry.Button = button
        entry.Activate = activate
        entry.KeyName = SavedConfig.Keybinds[id]
        entry.Capturing = false

        entry.Update = function()
            updateKeybindButton(entry)
        end

        entry.SetKey = function(keyName)
            if type(keyName) ~= "string" or keyName == "" then return end

            for otherId, other in pairs(Window.Keybinds) do
                if otherId ~= id and other.KeyName == keyName then
                    other.KeyName = nil
                    SavedConfig.Keybinds[otherId] = nil
                    if other.Update then other.Update() end
                end
            end

            entry.KeyName = keyName
            SavedConfig.Keybinds[id] = keyName
            entry.Capturing = false
            if Window._keybindCapture == entry then
                Window._keybindCapture = nil
            end
            updateKeybindButton(entry)
            SaveConfig()
        end

        entry.Clear = function()
            entry.KeyName = nil
            SavedConfig.Keybinds[id] = nil
            entry.Capturing = false
            if Window._keybindCapture == entry then
                Window._keybindCapture = nil
            end
            updateKeybindButton(entry)
            SaveConfig()
        end

        Window.Keybinds[id] = entry
        updateKeybindButton(entry)
        return entry
    end

    Window.ComboMembers = {}
    Window.ComboSlot = nil

    Window.RefreshComboLabel = function()
        if not Window.ComboSlot then return end
        local text
        if #Window.ComboMembers == 0 then
            text = GetText("Vacío", "Empty")
        else
            local initials = {}
            for _, member in ipairs(Window.ComboMembers) do
                table.insert(initials, member.Initial)
            end
            text = table.concat(initials, "+")
        end
        Window.ComboSlot.Label.Text = text
        if Window.ComboSlot.FloatLabel then
            Window.ComboSlot.FloatLabel.Text = text
        end
    end

    Window.AddComboMember = function(member)
        table.insert(Window.ComboMembers, member)
        Window.RefreshComboLabel()
    end

    Window.RemoveComboMember = function(member)
        for i, m in ipairs(Window.ComboMembers) do
            if m == member then
                table.remove(Window.ComboMembers, i)
                break
            end
        end
        Window.RefreshComboLabel()
    end

    track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, _gameProcessedEvent)
        local capture = Window._keybindCapture
        if capture then
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    capture.Capturing = false
                    Window._keybindCapture = nil
                    updateKeybindButton(capture)
                elseif input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    capture.SetKey(input.KeyCode.Name)
                end
            end
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end

        local focusedTextBox = nil
        pcall(function()
            focusedTextBox = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
        end)
        if focusedTextBox then return end

        local keyName = input.KeyCode.Name
        for _, entry in pairs(Window.Keybinds) do
            if entry.KeyName == keyName and type(entry.Activate) == "function" then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(entry.Activate)
                end)
                break
            end
        end
    end))

    pcall(function()
        Window.BackgroundVideo = mk("VideoFrame", {
            Name = "BackgroundVideo",
            Parent = ContentArea,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 15, 1, 30),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Video = "",
            Looped = true,
            Playing = false,
            Volume = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Active = false,
            ZIndex = 5,
        })
        corner(Window.BackgroundVideo, 8)
    end)
    Window.VideoBackgroundSupported = Window.BackgroundVideo ~= nil

    Window.ApplyFloatingStyle = function()
        local isCircleStyle = (SavedConfig.FloatingToggleStyle or "Pill") == "Circle"
        local floatW = isCircleStyle and 64 or 200
        local floatH = isCircleStyle and 64 or 36

        for _, floatData in ipairs(Window.FloatingToggles or {}) do
            local win = floatData and floatData.Window
            if win and win.Parent and win:GetAttribute("SupportsFloatStyle") and not win:GetAttribute("YYPillV5") then
                local winHasLinkedSlider = win:GetAttribute("HasLinkedSlider")
                local thisFloatW = winHasLinkedSlider and 200 or floatW
                local thisFloatH = winHasLinkedSlider and (36 + 40) or floatH
                local thisIsCircle = isCircleStyle and not winHasLinkedSlider

                local curCenterX = win.Position.X.Offset + win.Size.X.Offset / 2
                local curCenterY = win.Position.Y.Offset + win.Size.Y.Offset / 2

                win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thisFloatW, thisFloatH)
                win.Position = UDim2.new(
                    win.Position.X.Scale, curCenterX - thisFloatW / 2,
                    win.Position.Y.Scale, curCenterY - thisFloatH / 2
                )
                win.BackgroundTransparency = thisIsCircle and 0.55 or 0.30

                local existingGradient = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                if thisIsCircle then
                    if existingGradient then existingGradient:Destroy() end
                elseif not existingGradient then
                    mk("UIGradient", {
                        Color = ColorSequence.new({
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(240, 243, 250)),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)),
                        }),
                        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   0.45),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.15),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   0.45),
                        }),
                        Rotation = 90,
                    }, win)
                end

                local existingStroke = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if existingStroke then
                    existingStroke.Thickness = thisIsCircle and 3 or 2.5
                end

                local label = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                if label and not winHasLinkedSlider then
                    label.Size = thisIsCircle and UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24) or UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
                    label.Position = thisIsCircle and UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12) or UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
                    label.TextSize = thisIsCircle and 11 or 21
                    label.TextWrapped = thisIsCircle
                    label.TextTruncate = thisIsCircle and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                end
                if floatData.ClampPosition then
                    pcall(floatData.ClampPosition)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    Window.TopBarArt     = TopBarArt
    Window.TabListArt    = TabListArt

    local LibrarySizePresets = {
        Small  = { Width = 500,  Height = 430 },
        Large  = { Width = 760,  Height = 720 },
        PC     = { Width = 920,  Height = 620 },
    }

    local LibrarySizeMode = ((SavedConfig.LibrarySizeMode or "Small") == "Large") and "Large" or "Small"

    local function getCurrentLibraryPreset()
        return LibrarySizePresets[LibrarySizeMode] or LibrarySizePresets.Small
    end

    Window.DetectPlatformType = function()
        local preferredInput = nil
        pcall(function()
            local preferred = UserInputService.PreferredInput
            if preferred == Enum.PreferredInput.KeyboardAndMouse then
                preferredInput = "PC"
            elseif preferred == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then
                preferredInput = "Mobile"
            end
        end)
        if preferredInput then return preferredInput end

        local hasKeyboard, hasMouse, hasTouch = false, false, false
        pcall(function() hasKeyboard = UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled end)
        pcall(function() hasMouse    = UserInputService.MouseEnabled    end)
        pcall(function() hasTouch    = UserInputService.TouchEnabled    end)

        local screenX = 0
        pcall(function()
            screenX = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X
        end)

        if hasKeyboard and hasMouse and not hasTouch then return "PC"     end
        if hasTouch and not hasMouse and not hasKeyboard then return "Mobile" end
        return (screenX >= 1080) and "PC" or "Mobile"
    end

    Window.UpdateWindowSize = function()
        local effectiveMode = LibrarySizeMode

        local platformMode = SavedConfig.PlatformMode or "Auto"
        if platformMode == "Auto" then
            if Window.DetectPlatformType() == "PC" then
                effectiveMode = "PC"
            end
        elseif platformMode == "PC" then
            effectiveMode = "PC"
        end

        local preset = LibrarySizePresets[effectiveMode] or LibrarySizePresets.Small
        local screen  = ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
        local width   = preset.Width
        local height  = preset.Height

        if screen.X > 0 and screen.Y > 0 then
            width  = math.min(width,  math.floor(screen.X * 0.92))
            height = math.min(height, math.floor(screen.Y * 0.92))
        end

        shownSize = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
        if Main and not isMaximized then
            Main.Size        = shownSize
            normalWindowSize = shownSize
        end
    end

    Window.UpdateWindowSize()
    ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(Window.UpdateWindowSize)

    function Window:SetLibraryVersion(isLarge)
        LibrarySizeMode = isLarge and "Large" or "Small"
        self.LibrarySizeMode = LibrarySizeMode
        self.LibraryHeight = getCurrentLibraryPreset().Height
        SavedConfig.LibrarySizeMode = LibrarySizeMode
        SavedConfig.LibraryHeight = self.LibraryHeight
        SaveConfig()
        Window.UpdateWindowSize()
    end

    Window.LibrarySizeMode = LibrarySizeMode
    Window.LibraryHeight = getCurrentLibraryPreset().Height

    -- Opcional: reutiliza la mecanica de iconos de TestUI_sprite_v7 sin cambiar
    -- la navegacion original por defecto. Solo se activa desde Ajustes.
    local TabIconCarousel = {
        Enabled = false,
        Items = {},
        Offset = 0,
        Velocity = 0,
        ViewW = 0,
        Anim = nil,
        ActiveTab = nil,
        Spin = 0,
        LastOffset = 0,
    }

    local TAB_ICON_SIZE = 42
    local TAB_ICON_GAP = 6
    local TAB_ICON_STEP = TAB_ICON_SIZE + TAB_ICON_GAP
    local TAB_DRAG_THRESHOLD = 7
    local TAB_FRICTION = 4.2
    local TAB_SPIN_GAIN = 0.6
    local TAB_SPIN_MAX = 24
    local TAB_SPIN_DECAY = 9

    local function tabCarouselScale()
        local s = MainScale.Scale
        if type(s) ~= "number" or s < 0.05 then return 1 end
        return s
    end

    local function applyTabCarouselSpin()
        local spin = TabIconCarousel.Spin
        for _, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            local rotor = item.Tab and item.Tab.IconLabel
            if rotor then
                rotor.Rotation = spin * (0.6 + 0.8 * (item.Dist or 0))
            end
        end
    end

    local function renderTabCarousel()
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end
        local count = #TabIconCarousel.Items
        local viewW = TabIconCarousel.ViewW
        if count == 0 or viewW <= 0 then return end

        local length = count * TAB_ICON_STEP
        TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset % length
        local moved = ((TabIconCarousel.Offset - (TabIconCarousel.LastOffset or TabIconCarousel.Offset) + length / 2) % length) - length / 2
        TabIconCarousel.LastOffset = TabIconCarousel.Offset
        TabIconCarousel.Spin = math.clamp(TabIconCarousel.Spin - moved * TAB_SPIN_GAIN, -TAB_SPIN_MAX, TAB_SPIN_MAX)

        for index, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            local x = (((index - 1) * TAB_ICON_STEP - TabIconCarousel.Offset + TAB_ICON_SIZE) % length) - TAB_ICON_SIZE
            item.Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, x + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2, 0.5, 0)
            local d = math.abs((x + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2) - viewW / 2) / math.max(viewW / 2, 1)
            local edge = math.clamp((d - 0.6) / 0.4, 0, 1)
            item.Scale.Scale = 1 - 0.2 * edge
            item.Dist = math.clamp(d, 0, 1)
        end
        applyTabCarouselSpin()
    end

    local function focusTabCarousel(tab, animate)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled or TabIconCarousel.ViewW <= 0 then return end
        local index
        for i, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            if item.Tab == tab then
                index = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not index then return end

        local length = #TabIconCarousel.Items * TAB_ICON_STEP
        local target = (index - 1) * TAB_ICON_STEP + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2 - TabIconCarousel.ViewW / 2
        local delta = (target - TabIconCarousel.Offset + length / 2) % length - length / 2
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0

        if animate then
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = {
                From = TabIconCarousel.Offset,
                To = TabIconCarousel.Offset + delta,
                T0 = os.clock(),
                Dur = 0.35,
            }
        else
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset + delta
            renderTabCarousel()
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end
    end

    local function relayoutTabCarousel()
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end
        TabIconCarousel.ViewW = TabCarouselViewport.AbsoluteSize.X / tabCarouselScale()
        TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        renderTabCarousel()
        if TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab then
